certification.name: University of Colorado Fundamentals of Computer Network Security Specialization
certification.description: Four-course University of Colorado System specialization covering secure system design, applied cryptography and PKI, penetration testing basics, and firewalls and intrusion detection. Course-based certificate assessed through projects on cloud instances, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week (the page FAQ says about 16 weeks).
